newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains despite hefty NYMEX selloff.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains despite hefty NYMEX selloff.

text.p: NWE gasoline had a bumpy ride on Thursday as front month NYMEX gasoline came under heavy selling pressure ahead of expiry.

Initial gains in NWE of $2-3 were shaved when the NYMEX sell-off kicked in but because the pressure was more on August than further forward months the drop in cash prices was less severe than some first anticipated.
By the end of the day NWE gasoline was about $1 above Wednesday's levels and $1 or so below the days high.
Physical NWE material remains tight at least until mid August andbullish U.S. stocks data still holds true.
"The fundemental reasons that have pushed this market are still largely there," said one trader.

Wet business was fairly limited because of the tightness and swap activity was also a touch subdued compared with recent days. August swaps were pegged around $205-206 with September backwardated by $8-9 a tonne.
